name: URL to Markdown → LLM-ready text (Apify, publicrecords)

parameters.content:
## URL to Markdown (LLM-ready, pay-as-you-go)
Turn web page URLs into clean, LLM-ready Markdown at $0.0012/page, with no monthly subscription. Plain HTTP, no browser. A Firecrawl alternative and Jina Reader alternative for this job. Not a site crawler: you choose the URLs.

1. Replace `YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` in the Authorization header.
2. Edit the JSON body (`urls`) and click Test workflow.

Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/url-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/url-to-markdown

nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with your Apify API token (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at $0.0012/page, pay-as-you-go, no monthly subscription. Plain HTTP, no browser.
